verses.1: And the leaders of the tribes of Israel went to Elazar the priest, to Joshua son of Nun, and to the leaders of the tribes of Israel.
verses.2: And they spoke to them in Shiloh, in the land of Canaan, and said, “The LORD has commanded Moses to give us cities in which we may dwell, and from their ruins, we may make shelters for ourselves.”
verses.3: And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites the towns from their inheritance, as well as their suburbs.
verses.4: And the warrior went out to the tribes of Khati. He became one of Aaron’s priests from the Levites, from the region of Judah, from the region of Simeon, and from the region of Benjamin. In total, there were thirteen cities where he served as a warrior.
verses.5: And the towns of Kheresh, which were freed from the control of Mattah-Eفرיים and Mattah-Dan. They also included half of the towns belonging to Manasseh.
verses.6: And the towns of Gershon were taken from the families of Matti Yishashkar, Matti Ashir, Matti Nafthali, and from half of the land of Menashe. These towns were destroyed in battle. There were thirteen such towns in total.
verses.7: To the children of Merari, for their families: from Reuben’s tribe, and from Gad’s tribe, and from Zebulun’s tribe. There are twenty-two cities in total.
verses.8: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities and their suburbs, as Jehovah commanded through Moses at the Red Sea.
verses.9: And the sons of Judah and the sons of Shimeh gave to them these cities, which are called by those names.
verses.10: And the sons of Aaron were born from the daughters of Keturah. They were descendants of Levi, because they had Reishonah as their ancestor.
verses.11: And they gave them the territory of four Abi Ha’Anok. This territory includes Hebron in the mountain of Judea, as well as Megiddo and its surrounding areas.
verses.12: And the fields of the city and its courtyards were given to Caleb, son of Jephunah, for his possession.
verses.13: And the utensils of Aaron, the priest, were given to him: the city of Miklat, its suburbs, and its utensils.
verses.14: And Yatir, and Migreshah, and Eshtemoa, and Migreshah.
verses.15: And Hylon, and Migreshah, and Dvir, and Migreshah.
verses.16: And its walls, and its gates, and its towers. And the city itself, along with its ten districts, belongs to these two kingdoms.
verses.17: And from the top of Benyamin, he took his land and its hills.
verses.18: His questions, his demands, and his demands upon the cities. There were four such cities.
verses.19: All the cities of the sons of Aaron were thirteen cities, along with their suburbs.
verses.20: And to the descendants of Kehat, those who were freed from Kehat’s people. Their cities became important centers of power.
verses.21: And they gave them the city of Micpat, the hill where they buried their dead, as well as its surrounding land. They also gave them Gezer and its surrounding area.
verses.22: And Kibtsiyim, and Migreshah, and Bet Horon, and Migreshah – four cities in total.
verses.23: And from the mountaintop, they took Eltekha and Migreshah. They also took Givton and Migreshah.
verses.24: Etiyalon, Migreshah, Gathrimon, and Migreshah Arba’im.
verses.25: And half of Manasseh took away their towns, along with their fields and their villages.
verses.26: All the cities, along with their suburbs, became homes for the sons of Kedar who were freed from captivity.
verses.27: And the towns of Gershon came from the clans of the Levites. They took half of Manasseh’s territory: Micalat, Golan, Basan, Megiddo, and Be’er-Sheba. These were two cities.
verses.28: And from the hill of Issachar, he took Kishyon and Migrashah. He also took Dabrat and Migrashah.
verses.29: And Ether and Megirshah; and the towns of Eyn Ganim and Megirshah were four in number.
verses.30: And from the place where it was built, along with its foundations and pillars.
verses.31: Its parts, its streets, its squares, and its areas were four in number.
verses.32: And from the heights of Naphtali, I destroyed the city. I also destroyed the sacred sites in the valley, as well as Megashah and Hamot Dor. I also destroyed Karthan and Megashah. It was a group of six cities that I destroyed.
verses.33: All the cities of the Gerashenim belong to their families. There are thirteen cities in total, along with their surrounding areas.
verses.34: And to the descendants of Merari, those who were freed from the bondage of Zebulun. They inherited Yakanam and Migrasah, along with Karthah and Migrasah.
verses.35: Its walls and its gates; its high places and its cities were many.
verses.36: And from Mount Reuben, he saw Betzor and Migreshah. He also saw Yahtza and Migreshah.
verses.37: Its suburbs, its walls, and its gates were four in number.
verses.38: And from the heights of Gad, they destroyed the city of Miklat. They also destroyed the ramparts, the camps, and all the other structures there.
verses.39: His thoughts and his plans; all the cities are under his control. Four in total.
verses.40: All the cities were given to the descendants of Merari for their families who were separated from the families of Levi. In total, there were twelve such cities.
verses.41: All the cities of the Levites were under the control of the sons of Israel. There were forty-two cities, along with their suburbs.
verses.42: These cities were cities in their own right, with their surrounding areas also considered cities. The same applies to all these cities.
verses.43: And Jehovah gave Israel all the land that had been promised to their ancestors. They inherited it and settled there.
verses.44: And Jehovah gave them everything that their ancestors had enjoyed. No one stood in their way, and they faced all their enemies with confidence. Jehovah handed over all their enemies into their hands.
verses.45: Not a single word of all the good things that Jehovah has spoken to the house of Israel fell short.
